QA Send Basic.commands:
---
name: QA Send Basic
description: "Tests send command with capture, suppress, timeout, on_error, and _output. Requires: single-host SSH session to a POSIX-like shell with hostname, whoami, uname, ls, and echo available. Expected: pass."
version: 1
debug: true
steps:
  # Basic send and capture
  - send:
      command: hostname
      capture: host_result
  - print:
      message: "Captured hostname: ${host_result}"

  # Verify _output holds last command output
  - send:
      command: echo "hello world"
  - print:
      message: "Last output via _output: ${_output}"

  # Send with suppress (output hidden but capture still works)
  - send:
      command: whoami
      suppress: true
      capture: current_user
  - print:
      message: "Suppressed send captured user: ${current_user}"

  # Send with explicit timeout
  - send:
      command: uname -a
      timeout: 15
      capture: system_info
  - print:
      message: "System info: ${system_info}"

  # Send with on_error continue (command that may fail)
  - send:
      command: ls /nonexistent_path_xyz_qa_test 2>&1
      on_error: continue
      capture: error_output
  - print:
      message: "Error output (expected): ${error_output}"

  # Send multiple commands in sequence
  - send:
      command: echo "line1" && echo "line2" && echo "line3"
      capture: multi_output
  - print:
      message: "Multi-line output: ${multi_output}"

  - log:
      message: "Send Basic tests completed successfully"
      level: success

  - assert:
      condition: "host_result is not empty and current_user is not empty and system_info is not empty and error_output is not empty and multi_output contains 'line3'"
      message: "Expected send captures, on_error output, and multiline output to be populated"
  - exit: success PASS - QA Send Basic

QA Table.commands:
---
name: QA Table
description: "Tests table command with list, JSON string, JsonObject, JsonElement, and explicit columns. Requires: no special environment beyond normal script execution. Expected: pass."
version: 2
debug: true
steps:
  # Build a simple list and display as table
  - set:
      expression: "items = push(items, server-01)"
  - set:
      expression: "items = push(items, server-02)"
  - set:
      expression: "items = push(items, server-03)"
  - print:
      message: "--- Table from list (auto columns) ---"
  - table:
      data: "${items}"

  # Table from JSON array with auto columns
  - set:
      expression: "json_data = json([], json('host', '10.0.1.1', 'status', 'up', 'latency', '12ms'), json('host', '10.0.1.2', 'status', 'up', 'latency', '8ms'), json('host', '10.0.1.3', 'status', 'down', 'latency', '-'))"
  - print:
      message: "--- Table from JSON (auto columns) ---"
  - table:
      data: "${json_data}"

  # Table with explicit column definitions
  - print:
      message: "--- Table with explicit columns ---"
  - table:
      data: "${json_data}"
      columns:
        - header: Host
          field: host
          width: 15
        - header: Status
          field: status
          align: center
        - header: Latency
          field: latency
          align: right

  # Table with into (capture formatted output)
  - table:
      data: "${json_data}"
      into: formatted_table
      show_header: true
  - print:
      message: "--- Captured table ---"
  - print:
      message: "${formatted_table}"

  # Table from JsonObject runtime value (built via dot notation)
  - set:
      expression: "row_obj.host = edge-01"
  - set:
      expression: "row_obj.status = up"
  - table:
      data: "${row_obj}"
      into: row_obj_table
  - assert:
      condition: "row_obj_table contains 'edge-01'"
      message: "Expected JsonObject table output to include edge-01"

  # Table from JsonElement runtime value (json.get default array literal)
  - set:
      expression: "json_element_rows = json.get({}, 'missing', [{\"host\":\"je-1\",\"status\":\"up\"},{\"host\":\"je-2\",\"status\":\"down\"}])"
  - table:
      data: "${json_element_rows}"
      into: json_element_table
  - assert:
      condition: "json_element_table contains 'je-1' and json_element_table contains 'je-2'"
      message: "Expected JsonElement table output to include je-1 and je-2"

  # Table from JSON object string (single-row object)
  - set:
      expression: "single_row_json = {\"host\":\"single-host\",\"status\":\"up\"}"
  - table:
      data: "${single_row_json}"
      into: single_row_table
  - assert:
      condition: "single_row_table contains 'single-host'"
      message: "Expected JSON object string table output to include single-host"

  # Table with no header
  - print:
      message: "--- Table without header ---"
  - table:
      data: "${items}"
      show_header: false

  - log:
      message: "Table tests completed"
      level: success

  - exit: success PASS - QA Table

QA Parallel Loop Control.commands:
---
name: QA Parallel Loop Control
description: "Verifies break/continue propagation from parallel child steps. Requires: no special environment beyond normal script execution. Expected: pass."
version: 1
debug: true
steps:
  - set:
      expression: "i = 0"
  - set:
      expression: "marks = ''"

  - while:
      condition: "i < 5"
      max_iterations: 10
      do:
        - set:
            expression: "i = i + 1"
        - parallel:
            steps:
              - if:
                  condition: "i == 2"
                  then:
                    - continue: true
              - if:
                  condition: "i == 4"
                  then:
                    - break: true
        - set:
            expression: "marks = \"${marks}${i}\""

  - print:
      message: "Result: i=${i}, marks='${marks}' (expect i=4, marks='13')"
  - log:
      message: "Parallel loop-control test completed"
      level: success

  - assert:
      condition: "i == 4 and marks == '13'"
      message: "Parallel loop-control summary values did not match expectations"
  - exit: success PASS - QA Parallel Loop Control
